provider.description: Asynchronous transcription provider to use; selection may require separately configured provider credentials.

settings.description: Optional provider-relevant settings. Unsupported combinations are rejected rather than silently ignored; omitted settings retain provider defaults.

model.description: Selected provider model name; required for ElevenLabs; unsupported for providers without a corresponding documented model field.

diarize.description: Enable provider speaker diarization where supported; distinct from separate-stream diarization.

keyTerms.description: Recognition hints for providers with a key-term field; empty array sends an explicit empty list.

items.description: Recognition hint in the selected provider's vocabulary.

spelling.description: Exact find/replace entries for Recall.ai transcription only; empty array sends no replacements.

items.description: Source spelling to replace.

replace.description: Exact replacement text, preserving case and Unicode; empty text removes matches.

items.description: An exact spelling replacement entry.

recognizer.description: Google Speech V2 recognizer resource name; valid only with googleSpeechV2.

languageCode.description: Language code in the selected provider's vocabulary, for example en or en_us; omit for that provider's default or automatic behavior.

speechModels.description: AssemblyAI model names in priority order; valid only with assemblyAi.

items.description: AssemblyAI speech model name.

filterProfanity.description: Enable provider profanity filtering where supported; omit for provider default.

metadata.description: Custom metadata on the new transcript; omit for the provider default, {} for an explicit empty map.

useSeparateStreamsWhenAvailable.description: Request separate-stream diarization when available; omit for Recall's default.

FunctionInput_recall_ai_createtranscript.description: Submit a completed recording for asynchronous transcription with one selected provider.

recordingId.description: Associated recording ID returned by Recall.

createdAt.description: Transcript artifact creation instant in UTC.

statusCode.description: Artifact state: processing, done, failed, or deleted; submission does not imply done.

metadata.description: Custom metadata returned on the transcript artifact.

downloadUrl.description: Transcript download URL; normally null until ready.

providerDataDownloadUrl.description: Raw transcription provider-data URL, or null if unavailable.

FunctionOutput_recall_ai_createtranscrip.description: Immediate transcript artifact acknowledgement, not a completed transcript or delivery guarantee.

tags.instructions: Obtain a recording ID from `list-recordings` or `get-desktop-sdk-upload`, then check completion with `get-recording`. This submits work and may incur transcription charges; it does not wait for completion. Do not blindly replay an uncertain submission. Provider settings are optional typed choices, not an encoded request.

functions.name: get-billing-usage

startAt.description: Inclusive usage-range start instant with explicit UTC marker or numeric offset. Exact bounds are preserved; omit to leave the lower bound unspecified.

FunctionInput_recall_ai_getbillingusage.description: Optional exact timestamp bounds for workspace bot usage; omit both for full workspace history.

botUsageSeconds.description: Total bot usage in seconds for the authenticated workspace and requested bounds, preserving fractional seconds. This is not a monetary charge or an invoice.

FunctionOutput_recall_ai_getbillingusage.description: Workspace bot-usage total in seconds, not an invoice or a guaranteed final billed amount.

tags.instructions: Use this for a workspace bot-usage total, not an artifact count or invoice. Omit both bounds for full workspace history. Start is inclusive and end is exclusive. Covered UTC-day ranges use completion-attributed billed usage subject to ingestion delay; historical/sub-day ranges and billing-provider failures use joining-attributed legacy usage. Allow for these differences when comparing totals. This endpoint permits only 5 requests per minute per workspace.
